nome: isalnum, isalpha, isdigit e ispunct em letras, dígito e pontuação
c:
const char *s = "a1B?";
    for (int i = 0; s[i]; i++) printf("%c %d %d %d %d\n", s[i], isalnum(s[i]) != 0, isalpha(s[i]) != 0, isdigit(s[i]) != 0, ispunct(s[i]) != 0);

nome: isblank, iscntrl, isspace no espaço, na tabulação e na quebra de linha
c:
int cs[] = {' ', '\t', '\n', 127, 'x'};
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d %d %d\n", isblank(cs[i]) != 0, iscntrl(cs[i]) != 0, isspace(cs[i]) != 0);

nome: isgraph, isprint, islower, isupper e isxdigit
c:
const char *s = "a Z9g~";
    for (int i = 0; s[i]; i++) printf("%d%d%d%d%d\n", isgraph(s[i]) != 0, isprint(s[i]) != 0, islower(s[i]) != 0, isupper(s[i]) != 0, isxdigit(s[i]) != 0);

nome: tolower e toupper, e o EOF que volta igual
c: printf("%c%c%c %d %d\n", toupper('a'), tolower('B'), toupper('1'), tolower(EOF), toupper(EOF));
jinga: printf("%c%c%c %d %d\n", toupper(ord("a")), tolower(ord("B")), toupper(ord("1")), tolower(EOF), toupper(EOF))
